expectations.text: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
expectations.evidence: check_app.R: 0 error(s), 1 warning (server reads col, x, y not in UI). Those inputs are created inside renderUI with session$ns, so the warning is a false positive, not a real defect.

expectations.text: There are three module pairs (UI function using NS(id) + server function using moduleServer()), one per tab; callModule() is not used.
expectations.evidence: dataUI/dataServer, plotUI/plotServer, modelUI/modelServer in app.R; NS(id) + moduleServer(); no callModule.

expectations.text: The selected dataset from the Data module is returned as a reactive and passed into the Plot and Model modules (not re-selected in each tab, not read via a global variable).
expectations.evidence: testServer(dataServer): returned value is.reactive=TRUE; server passes it to plotServer and modelServer.

expectations.text: In the Plot and Model tabs, column choices update when the dataset changes, and only numeric columns are offered where a numeric column is required.
expectations.evidence: renderUI rebuilds selectInputs from numeric_cols(data()); after switching to ToothGrowth testServer output$col_ui / xy_ui contain 'len' and not 'supp'.

expectations.text: The model fit runs only when its button is clicked (bindEvent/eventReactive/observeEvent) and shows progress via withProgress/incProgress, Progress$new, or ExtendedTask with input_task_button.
expectations.evidence: eventReactive(input$fit, ...) with withProgress/incProgress loop; normal fit produced Coefficients.

expectations.text: URL bookmarking is enabled (enableBookmarking('url') or shinyApp(..., enableBookmarking = 'url')) and the UI is a function of request; a bookmark button or automatic URL update is present.
expectations.evidence: ui <- function(request); shinyApp(..., enableBookmarking='url'); bookmarkButton in navbar; DT inputs and fit excluded from bookmark.

expectations.text: Choosing the same column for x and y in the Model tab produces a readable message instead of fitting y ~ y (which yields a warning and a meaningless summary).
expectations.evidence: testServer: x=y='Sepal.Length', fit=1 -> summary printed 'lm(formula = Sepal.Length ~ Sepal.Length)' with intercept-only coefficients plus model.matrix warnings; no readable message.

expectations.text: Clicking Fit while the x/y column inputs are still NULL does not raise an R error (guarded by req() or equivalent that handles NULL).
expectations.evidence: testServer: fit=1 with x/y NULL -> req(input$x %in% names(df)) gives shiny.silent.error (logical(0) is falsy); no R error.

suggestions.assertion: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
suggestions.reason: check_app.R flags renderUI-created inputs as missing; consider ignoring ids built with session$ns inside renderUI.

eval_feedback.overall: Solid single-file app; only misses the x==y guard.
